results.name: MP-A5 F1 — the staging-v1 map keeps entitlements, plan and billing OFF; the TEST overlay turns exactly those three on
MP-A5 F2 — billing mode matrix: only test + hybrid + loopback gateway/Core/app + non-production environment is ON
MP-A5 F3 — Production can never carry billing: env files, Vercel config and the prebuild
MP-A5 F4 — no Mercado Pago secret or payments configuration is readable by the frontend
MP-A5 S1 — the frontend commerce scope is exactly the MP-A4 gateway contract: 2 reads + the fixed checkout path
MP-A5 S2 — the client reaches the commerce reads and the checkout only when built with commerce; nothing else widens
MP-A5 T1 — commerce(): POST to the fixed path with the bridge bearer, exact JSON body, no credentials, no-store, redirect error
MP-A5 T2 — commerce() refuses any other path, method-less or non-object body before the network
MP-A5 T3 — per-call timeout: the checkout uses its own deadline, not the RPC default
MP-A5 T4 — 401 renews the bridge once and repeats once; a second 401 is terminal
MP-A5 T5 — 400/403/409/413/502/503 are single attempts; business and dependency codes are preserved
MP-A5 T6 — the RPC/table semantics of send() are unchanged by the commerce channel
MP-A5 V1 — without commerce the hybrid service has no commerce method at all
MP-A5 V2 — loadSeasonEntitlements uses exactly get_effective_tournament_season_entitlements
MP-A5 V3 — loadPurchase reads get_tournament_purchase and fails closed on another org, season or purchase
MP-A5 V4 — createCheckout sends exactly {organizationId, seasonId, idempotencyKey}; never price, provider, currency or environment
MP-A5 V5 — createCheckout validates the answer: stale purchase + valid preference is OK; foreign or malformed answers fail closed
MP-A5 V6 — error mapping: 400 input, 401 session, 403 permission, 409 business (suspended is its own code), 502 contract, 503 unavailable
MP-A5 G1 — Plan and PurchaseStatus import neither the legacy service nor a Supabase client: commerce comes from the injected context
MP-A5 G2 — routing: season plan + purchase status are gated by `plan`; every legacy Plan route stays behind `plan_legacy_routes`
